record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.original_question: Let (M^n, g) be a Riemannian manifold with Ric ≥ −λ. Does there exist a constant C(n, λ) such that the scalar curvature satisfies the local bound ∫_(B_1(p)) R ≤ C(n, λ) for every unit ball B_1(p)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.5 (local Yau conjecture). Let Mn, g satisfy Ric ≥ −λ, then ∫B1(p) R ≤ C(n, λ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let n ≥ 2 be an integer and λ ≥ 0 a real constant. Suppose (M^n, g) is a smooth complete Riemannian manifold of dimension n whose Ricci curvature satisfies Ric ≥ −λ g everywhere. Let R denote the scalar curvature of g, and for p ∈ M let B_1(p) denote the open geodesic ball of radius 1 centered at p.

Question: Does there exist a constant C(n, λ), depending only on n and λ, such that
   ∫_{B_1(p)} R \, d\mathrm{vol}_g  ≤  C(n, λ)
for every such (M^n, g) and every p ∈ M?

(Note: no upper bound on Ricci or sectional curvature, no noncollapsing assumption, and no injectivity radius bound is assumed.)
artifact.status_search_result: The conjectured local L^1 bound on scalar curvature under only a lower Ricci bound (a local version of Yau's problem) appears to remain open in this generality. Petrunin established such a bound assuming a lower sectional curvature bound, and Cheeger–Naber obtained integral bounds on the full Riemann tensor under two-sided Ricci bounds with noncollapsing; the case of only a lower Ricci bound (allowing collapse) is still open.

status_evidence.title: An upper bound for curvature integral — Anton Petrunin
status_evidence.snippet: Petrunin obtains an integral bound for the scalar curvature assuming a lower bound on the sectional curvature, including in the collapsed setting.
status_evidence.claim: A scalar curvature integral bound is known under a lower sectional (not just Ricci) curvature bound.

status_evidence.title: Manifolds with Integral Ricci Curvature Lower Bounds (Duke SCSHGAP notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Yau conjectured a similar bound for the scalar curvature under only a lower bound on the Ricci curvature; this remains open and a local version is proposed.
status_evidence.claim: The local Yau conjecture on scalar curvature under a lower Ricci bound is still open.

status_evidence.title: L^2 Curvature Bounds on Manifolds with Bounded Ricci Curvature (Cheeger–Naber)
status_evidence.snippet: Integral bounds for the full Riemann tensor are obtained assuming two-sided Ricci bounds and noncollapsing.
status_evidence.claim: Known integral curvature bounds require stronger hypotheses than just a lower Ricci bound.
